answer: Reputation accrues only from attested peer work, and withdrawal sits on a cliff ledge for a challenge window, letting peers slash proven duplicates before funds unlock. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked on-chain for an epoch; to register a new identity, an attacker must post an equal pearl deposit, so spawning N sybils costs N times the bond. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
